why: Body says Kamindu Mendis and Dhananjaya de Silva 'added an unbroken stand of more than 50'; Sri Lanka were 65 for 3 when Udara fell and 114 for 3 at stumps, so the stand is 49, not more than 50. The Hindi twin repeats the error ('नाबाद 50 से ज़्यादा रन की साझेदारी'). Also only two debutant fifties are named (Tayyab Arif 57, Mohammad Taha 51) while the headline and copy say three; Minhas is described separately as reaching his first Test fifty, so the third debutant is never identified.
